GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Went back from the gate settled second last 10 Lengths (800m), taken Wide improving To The Turn , widest for home couldn't get to them # too far back
Jumped ok balanced up Two Wide fourth well placed 3 Lengths (1000m), on the move 3 Wide approaching Turn , Straightened Up all Clear 2 Lengths trying to close the margin, couldn't # couldn't run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount travelled well during the race but failed to let down in the home straight as expected-added gelding may not have appreciated track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, missed start 1 length and Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then kept coming in Straight # battled on ok
Jumped ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5 Lengths off the lead Two Wide (800m), cornered similar looking to weave home, battled away ok held Ground the majority # fitter for that
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Ridden Along Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths and Inside winner, held-up @ 400m into Clear Outside x 300m kept trying without threatening to win - # no run vital stage
Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear led x 1 Lengths Turning for home Kept Running too good - # made own luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. A post-race vet exam revealed heat-stress.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7 Lengths off the lead Two Wide worse Mid Field (1000m), improving before Turn , Straightened Up now to the Outside all Clear within a couple of lengths, couldn't sustain however stuck on # sound running on
Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Drifted Back Settled Down well back Outside 7 Lengths Two Wide with cover To The Turn held-up / Restricted Room Not Knocked About until late- # Inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced in middle stages. Held up for clear run passing the 200m. When quest re tactics adopted & if there was an opportunity to improve into a run near 200m, Rdr stated when approaching that point, was mindful of weakening runner & when weighing up options, was of view there was insufficient room to improve into the run, therefore committed to shifting out around heels, however when doing so, weakening runner rolled out marginally, becoming awkwardly placed outside heels of that runner, halting the momentum of mount. Cast the right hind plate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Eased early & raced @ rear Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed out Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & chased soundly in last 200m. # Sound from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased from heels shortly after the start. Eased from heels close to the finish line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat back 5l off 3 Wide trail, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, running on took over 100m and drew clear # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was steadied and shifted wider after becoming awkwardly placed close to the heels.
